test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All houses are trees.

All trees are stones.

All stones are rocks.

**Conclusion (I):** Some stones are trees.

**Conclusion (II):** All houses are rocks.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38d8f07b58528d0ec5a114e83b5b83a88e5cd1d29138ce768466ce334caf59c5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some stones are trees → Follow (As all trees are stones. As all trees comes in stones, therefore it is true.)

II. All houses are rocks → Follow (As all houses are trees, all trees are stones and all stones are rocks. As whole houses comes in trees which which whole comes in stones which whole comes in rocks, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
